safety.title: Safety
safety.disclaimer: This is general guidance from an automated coach, not medical advice.
safety.deferralLine: This is general guidance from an automated coach, not medical advice. Because of what you told me, talk to your doctor (or the professional named above) before acting on it.
safety.parqPending: Your PAR-Q+ is missing: until you answer it, light-to-moderate work only.
safety.error: Your safety notes could not be loaded.

welcome.title: Welcome to <neon>FightLab</neon>
welcome.subtitle: Your corner, in and out of the gym.
welcome.f1Title: Know how to show up to train
welcome.f1Body: — your daily status from your own recovery metrics.
welcome.f2Body: — MMA, gym and sports with training load and a round timer.
welcome.f3Body: — macros that fit you and the weigh-in always in sight.
welcome.resume: Pick up where you left off

language.title: Language and <neon>region</neon>
language.intro: The app, the coach and the safety notes will speak to you in this language.
language.otherNote: There is no region for your country yet: menus use the general food table and Open Food Facts products.
language.emergencyLabel: Which number do you call in an emergency where you live?
language.emergencyHint: 112 across the EU, 911 in the US, Canada and Mexico, 999 in the UK, 000 in Australia. If you are not sure, keep 112 and check it.
language.emergencyInvalid: Enter a number of 2 to 6 digits.

scoff.title: You and <neon>food</neon>
scoff.intro: Before we talk about weight, five short questions. It is not a diagnosis: it tells us whether to avoid deficits and weigh-ins.
scoff.question: Does any of this happen to you?

items.sick: Making yourself sick when uncomfortably full
items.control: Worry about losing control over how much you eat
items.fat: Feeling fat when others say you are thin
items.dominate: Food or weight dominating your thoughts or life
items.weightLoss: A recent large weight loss that worried you or others

scoff.followUp: Does it happen often, or does it bother you a fair amount?
scoff.followUpControl: Do you have episodes of eating a lot while feeling unable to stop?
scoff.incomplete: Answer all five questions to continue.
scoff.single: Noted. A single yes is not a positive screen; we will keep an eye on it.
scoff.positive: From your answers, FightLab will not suggest deficits, weight targets or weigh-ins.
scoff.redoNote: If things change or a professional reviews you, you can redo it from your profile.

basics.title: The basics <neon>about you</neon>
basics.intro: We use this for your zones, your energy needs and your targets. Only you can see it.
basics.dobHint: Your age sets your heart-rate zones.
basics.heightHint: With your weight, it sets your calories and macros.
basics.heightInvalid: Enter a valid height in cm (100–230).
basics.genderHint: It refines your resting metabolic rate.
basics.equationSex: The energy equations exist only for female and male. Which one should we use?
basics.equationSexHint: If you do not choose, there are no calorie or macro targets. Zones, plan and check-in work the same, and you can choose later in your profile.
basics.weightHint: It is the starting point for your targets. You can skip it.
basics.weightGentle: Are you happy to share an approximate weight for the estimates? It is optional, and you do not need to weigh yourself.
basics.weightInvalid: Enter a valid weight in kg (30–250).
basics.under18: For under-18s, FightLab gives no calorie targets and no weigh-ins.

dobErrors.incomplete: Complete the date (day, month and a 4-digit year).
dobErrors.invalid: That date does not exist. Check the day and month.
dobErrors.future: Your date of birth cannot be in the future.

parq.title: PAR-Q+, <neon>ready for exercise</neon>
parq.intro: The PAR-Q+ is the official questionnaire that tells you whether to check with a professional before becoming more physically active.
parq.openNote: It opens on eparmedx.com in a new tab. We do not copy it into the app: the official form must not be modified. Fill it in and come back here.
parq.anyYes: Any YES on the 7 general questions?
parq.followupYes: Any YES on the follow-up questions?
parq.unsure: I don't know or haven't filled it in
parq.unsureNote: Without the PAR-Q+, light-to-moderate work only. We will remind you.
parq.vigorous: Has a qualified exercise professional or clinician reviewed vigorous or maximal work for you (HIIT, 1RM tests, all-out sprints)?

cardiac.title: Warning <neon>signs</neon>
cardiac.question: Do you have any of these symptoms?
symptoms: Chest, neck, jaw or arm pain or pressure
Breathlessness at rest or with mild effort
cardiac.unsureAgain: Look at the list once more: have you noticed any of these symptoms lately?
cardiac.unsureStored: OK. If any of them appears, stop training and see a doctor.
cardiac.now: Is it happening now or at rest?
cardiac.stopTitle: Stop here and seek medical care
cardiac.stopBody: Do not exercise. For chest pain at rest, fainting, or chest pain with breathlessness and sweating, call emergency services now.

medical.title: Medication and <neon>health</neon>
medical.intro: Only some of these change what the coach works out. Tick the ones you have.

tokens.beta_blocker: Beta-blocker (bisoprolol, atenolol, metoprolol, propranolol, nebivolol, carvedilol)
tokens.glp1: GLP-1 or tirzepatide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus, Saxenda, Victoza, Trulicity, Mounjaro)
tokens.hypertension: Hypertension (high blood pressure or BP medication)
tokens.weight_related_condition: A condition your doctor links to weight (type 2 diabetes, sleep apnoea, fatty liver…)

medical.otherHint: Comma-separated. The coach cannot classify them: they are stored as given.

bp.title: Your <neon>blood pressure</neon>
bp.intro: Your latest seated reading, after 5 minutes of rest.
bp.unknown: If you don't know it, leave it empty and take one before your next check-in.

cycle.title: Your <neon>cycle</neon>
cycle.question: How are your periods?

states.absent: Absent 3 months or more (or fewer than 6 a year)

cycle.contraceptionNote: It masks the cycle: report low energy, low libido or stress fractures at your check-in.

goals.title: Your <neon>goal</neon> and training
goals.goal: What are you after right now?
goals.recompositionHint: Recomposition: eat around maintenance while you train. For beginners, returning lifters and higher body fat.

experiences.novice: Under 12 months of consistent training (about 2 or more sessions a week)
experiences.intermediate: 12 months or more, and still adding load or reps most months
experiences.advanced: 12 months or more, and progress has slowed to a plateau

activities.desk: Desk job with little exercise, or a few sessions a week
activities.desk_training: Desk job and about 1 h of training on 4 or more days a week
activities.active: Physical job, or daily moderate-to-vigorous exercise plus lots of daily movement

goals.frequency: How many days a week do you train?

done.title: Your starting <neon>point</neon>
done.intro: This is what FightLab will keep in mind from what you told us.
